text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Teaching and school administration are female-majority fields in most countries, so an all-women panel is unremarkable — it's roughly what chance produces. Leading with it makes you look like you're explaining away a loss rather than questioning a process, and it costs you credibility with the people who decide what happens next.

Your real grounds are concrete: you hold a master's in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal; the announcement credits her with "courses" and classroom experience. That's a formal-qualifications gap worth asking about. So is a two-week silence on a written request you're likely entitled to.

Send a follow-up demanding the written reasons, including how formal qualifications were weighted. Decide after you read them.
